definitions.occupied: clipped union of per-NPU [admission,completion); disjointness independently checked
definitions.tail_idle: per-NPU interval after its last request completion, including after whole-batch completion
definitions.first_card_empty: earliest per-NPU LAST completion, not last admission when waiting FIFO first becomes empty
definitions.active_normalized: compute/occupied is supplementary and changes the denominator; not device U
definitions.full_population: same 1212 requests across all 30 runs; original C/V preserved by prior audits
definitions.statistics: five seeds equally weighted; sample SD uses n-1; all seven windows retained
definitions.capacity: inherited prior complete event scan bound to raw result SHA; not rescanned here
definitions.scope: existing finite-batch results only; no longer-input or steady-state experiment was run
